results.title: Best Beacons alternative in 2026
results.content:
Linktree is the original link-in-bio tool and still the most widely recognised. Its free plan has no transaction fees, which already makes it a cleaner starting point than Beacons for creators who aren't yet selling anything.

Linktree is simpler and cheaper than Beacons, but it also does far less. There's no digital product sales, no email marketing, no booking. It's a step sideways from Beacons, not a step up.

Pros:

 Free plan with no transaction fees
 Widely recognised brand
 Simple
 Fast to set up

Cons:

 No portfolio in free plan
 no booking in free plan
 No digital product sales in free plan
 No real customization on the free plan

Pricing: Free plan available. Paid from $8/month. [...] Stan Store removes transaction fees from $29/month, which is cheaper than Beacons' equivalent tier. But it has no visual portfolio, which limits it to creators whose only goal is selling downloads or courses. It still has several built-in booking tools.

Pros:

 Clean product-selling flow
 Course hosting built in
 0% transaction fees on paid plan
 Easy setup

Cons:

 $29/month with no free trial
 No portfolio display, no booking tools
 Not suited to visual creatives or service-based creators

Pricing: $29/month.

Best for: Online coaches and digital product sellers whose sole goal is selling courses or downloads, not showcasing work or booking clients.

### Linktree: Best for Creators Who Only Need a Simple Link List [...] Pricing: Free plan available. Paid from $8/month.

Best for: Creators who only need a navigation hub and have no plans to sell or book clients from their bio link anytime soon.

### Squarespace: Best for Creators Who Want a Full Standalone Website

Squarespace is a full website builder, not a link-in-bio tool. But it's a natural consideration for creators who feel Beacons are too limited visually and want something with serious design quality behind it. It offers premium templates, e-commerce, and scheduling tools in one platform.

It's far more powerful visually than Beacons, but also significantly more complex and expensive to set up. It's not designed for social-first creators who need something live from their bio link in minutes.
